title: Bias correction for quantile regression estimators
California Gasoline Demand Elasticity Estimated Using Refinery Outages
abstract: This paper presents new gasoline demand price elasticity estimates for California. We use unique characteristics of California’s gasoline market and a new set of proposed instruments. As a first step, we take advantage of California’s unique gasoline market, which is partially isolated from the rest of the United States due to environmental regulations. We control for persistent demand shocks and estimate a lower bound for the long-run elasticity of demand of -0.23. In the second step, we use a new set of instruments to control for simultaneity. We use detailed information on refinery outages to capture short-run supply shocks. Our estimate of long-run demand elasticity is -0.60.
abstract_zh: 本文给出了加利福尼亚州汽油需求价格弹性的新估计。我们利用加州汽油市场的独特特征，以及一组新提出的工具变量。第一步，我们利用加州独特的汽油市场——由于环境管制，该市场与美国其他地区部分隔离——的特点。我们控制了持续性的需求冲击，并估计出长期需求弹性的下界为-0.23。第二步，我们使用一组新的工具变量来控制联立性问题。我们利用炼油厂停产的详细信息来捕捉短期供给冲击。我们估计的长期需求弹性为-0.60。

On model selection criteria for climate change impact studies
abstract: Climate change impact studies inform policymakers on the estimated damages of future climate change on economic, health and other outcomes. In most studies, an annual outcome variable is observed, e.g. agricultural yield, along with a higher-frequency regressor, e.g. daily temperature. Applied researchers then face a problem of selecting a model to characterize the nonlinear relationship between the outcome and the high-frequency regressor to make a policy recommendation based on the model-implied damage function. We show that existing model selection criteria are only suitable for the policy objective if one of the models under consideration nests the true model. If all models are seen as imperfect approximations of the true nonlinear relationship, the model that performs well in the historical climate conditions is not guaranteed to perform well at the projected climate. We therefore propose a new criterion, the proximity-weighted mean squared error (PWMSE) that directly targets precision of the damage function at the projected future climate. To make this criterion feasible, we assign higher weights to historical years that can serve as “weather analogs” to the projected future climate when evaluating competing models using the PWMSE. We show that our approach selects the best approximate regression model that has the smallest weighted squared error of predicted impacts for a projected future climate. A simulation study and an application revisiting the impact of climate change on agricultural production illustrate the empirical relevance of our theoretical analysis.
abstract_zh: 气候变化影响研究为政策制定者提供未来气候变化在经济、健康及其他结果方面造成损失的估计。在大多数研究中，观测到的是年度结果变量（例如农业单产），同时还有频率更高的解释变量（例如日气温）。应用研究者随后面临模型选择问题，即需要选择一个模型来刻画结果与高频解释变量之间的非线性关系，并据此基于模型隐含的损失函数提出政策建议。我们证明，现有的模型选择准则只有在所考虑的模型之一嵌套真实模型的情况下，才适用于上述政策目标。如果将所有模型都视为真实非线性关系的不完美近似，那么在历史气候条件下表现良好的模型，并不能保证在预测的气候条件下同样表现良好。因此，我们提出了一个新的准则——邻近加权均方误差（PWMSE），它直接以预测的未来气候条件下损失函数的精度为目标。为了使该准则可行，我们对可以作为预测未来气候“天气类比”的历史年份赋予较高权重，并利用PWMSE评估相互竞争的模型。我们证明，该方法能够选出在预测未来气候条件下，预测影响的加权平方误差最小的最优近似回归模型。模拟研究以及一个重新考察气候变化对农业生产影响的应用实例，说明了我们理论分析的实证相关性。
